## Summary
Describe the work item in 1-3 sentences.
 
## Type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Enhancement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Maintenance/refactor
- [ ] Other
 
## Why This Matters
Describe the expected value, impact, or problem being solved.
 
## Proposed Changes
List the key changes you plan to make.
 
## Validation
Describe how this will be checked (test steps, expected output, or manual review).
 
## Dependencies or Related Links
Add related issues, pull requests, docs, or external references.
 
## Notes
Add any additional context, assumptions, or constraints.
